b: Weekend Wisdom: When you measure your worth by what you get done, it’s never enough. Measure less by what’s on your list and more by what’s on your heart.

With the darker days, I’m embracing cozy time in the early morning and evening and getting out the door in between. From walking outside to working/writing in new to me coffee shops, it helps me stay in the flow of creativity. On my creative list lately is making gifts for 31 Days of Gifts. If you’ve been thinking about joining, now is the time! It will likely be the least amount you spend on something (and you don’t even have to wrap it). Gift this to yourself and everyone you love.

I’m also working on a special, free decluttering challenge coming up in January (you are going to want to take part in this). And of course, I’m writing, writing, writing. I discovered I’m more at peace and fulfilled when I let all the words out, even if no one ever sees them.

Oh hi! I'm Courtney and I've been simplifying my life since 2010. I remove the things that remove me from life. Things like clutter, debt, alcohol, busyness and drama. Now I have time for the good stuff like peace, ease, creativity, laughter and love. Let's simplify together, not so we can have a simple life, but so we can have the life we really want.
